summary: The Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology is a graduate university in Japan that teaches its PhD in English. Students receive financial support of about 2.6 million yen in the first year, rising to about 3.6 million yen, and live in subsidised campus housing. Applicants need a bachelor's or master's degree.
meta_title: OIST PhD Program 2027: funded PhD in Okinawa, Japan
meta_description: OIST's PhD in Okinawa pays about 2.6 to 3.6 million yen a year, with campus housing. A bachelor's is enough to apply. Apply by 15 November 2026.
covers: Financial support of about 2.6 million yen in the first year, rising with academic progress to about 3.6 million yen. It is taxable.
OIST says this support is enough for a comfortable standard of living, including the tuition fee.
Subsidised campus housing: a furnished single apartment costs 21,600 yen a month. PhD students live on campus for at least their first year.
Travel to conferences in Japan and abroad is budgeted separately.
eligibility: Applicants with a bachelor's or master's degree, or who expect to finish one before enrolling. A master's is not required.
OIST states no nationality limit. International students arrange their own student visa.

An English score (TOEFL iBT or IELTS from the last two years) is needed if your degree was taught or examined in another language. OIST sets no minimum; it uses the score to decide on preparatory courses.
how_to_apply: Apply online by 23:59 Japan time on 15 November 2026, and pay the 5,000 yen application fee.
Ask 2 to 5 professors to send recommendation letters. You can submit only after at least two have arrived.
Shortlisted applicants hear in late December 2026 and join the online Admissions Workshop interviews between 18 January and 7 February 2027.
Final results come in mid-February 2027. You can enrol on 1 May 2027, 1 September 2027 or 1 January 2028.
watch_out: The application fee is not refundable, and OIST offers no fee waivers at present.
Letters from lab members or postdocs are not accepted, and OIST does not accept letters you send yourself.
The online interviews are mandatory. The dates may change, so watch your email.
costs: OIST's financial support, about 2.6 million yen in year one
You, at a subsidised rent from 21,600 yen a month
Student visa and travel to Japan
documents: A statement of purpose of no more than 800 words.
2 to 5 recommendation letters in English from professorial-level faculty.
A TOEFL iBT or IELTS score, if your degree was not taught in English.
A passport or other government ID, and an ID photo taken within the last three months.

faq.q: Do I need a master's to apply to the OIST PhD?
faq.a: No. OIST takes applicants with a bachelor's or a master's degree, or who expect to finish one before enrolling.

faq.q: How much does OIST pay PhD students?
faq.a: About 2.6 million yen in the first year, rising with academic progress to about 3.6 million yen. The support is taxable.

faq.q: When is the OIST PhD deadline?
faq.a: 23:59 Japan time on 15 November 2026, for entry in May 2027, September 2027 or January 2028.
